evals.name: full-pipeline-topic-plus-seeds
evals.expected_output: Resolves the library_dir work root, snapshots llms.txt and the sitemap into discovery/, runs parse_discovery.py per snapshot, authors link-map.json classifying every discovered URL with rung provenance, passes check_linkmap.py, presents the map and bounds for user approval, then per in-corpus resource snapshots the original, runs extract_nodes.py, authors inventory.json with per-node verdicts and byte-verified evidence, passes check_inventory.py, and emits queue.json plus mapper-handoff.md.
expectations: Every discovered URL appears in link-map.json with a classification and rung provenance before any bulk fetch
User approval of the link map precedes resource ingestion
manifest.json is produced by extract_nodes.py, never authored by the agent
Every inventory row's evidence token passes check_inventory.py byte verification
Ends at queue.json + mapper-handoff.md; digesting is left to /knowledge:docpage-digest

evals.name: single-page-routes-to-docpage-digest
evals.prompt: Use /knowledge:map-corpus to ingest this one documentation page: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort
evals.expected_output: Declines to run the corpus pipeline over a single page and routes to /knowledge:docpage-digest, which owns one-page ingestion.
expectations: Does not run discovery over a single-page request

evals.name: no-discovery-artifacts-stops-loudly
evals.prompt: Run /knowledge:map-corpus "internal wiki" https://wiki.internal.example where the site serves neither llms.txt nor any sitemap.
evals.expected_output: Stops loudly at discovery: reports that neither rung 1 (llms.txt) nor rung 2 (sitemap) resolved, names the deferred rung-3 decision (user-reserved: a presence-gated firecrawl map seam versus a recorded reimplementation), and asks the user rather than crawling in-page links.
expectations: Does not extract in-page links as a fallback
Names the deferred rung-3 decision and that its arbiter is the user
Does not silently classify the corpus as empty

evals.name: bounds-breach-stops-and-asks
evals.prompt: During a /knowledge:map-corpus run with --max-resources 10, classification yields 14 in-corpus URLs.
evals.expected_output: check_linkmap.py fails with a named BOUNDS BREACH; the skill either narrows the in-corpus set or asks the user to raise the bound — it never quietly raises the bound or proceeds past the failure.
expectations: The breach surfaces as a gate failure, not a silent adjustment
The user decides between narrowing the map and raising the bound

evals.name: gate-failure-is-never-clean
evals.prompt: During Phase 4 of a /knowledge:map-corpus run, check_inventory.py exits non-zero because one row's evidence quote does not byte-match the snapshot.
evals.expected_output: Treats the run as failed for that resource, fixes the inventory row (relocating the quote by byte-search within the node span), re-runs the gate to PASS, and never edits the immutable snapshot or reports coverage while a gate is failing.
expectations: The snapshot is never modified to satisfy the gate
Coverage is not claimed while any gate fails
The corrected inventory re-passes check_inventory.py before the run continues

evals.name: does-not-touch-docpage-digest
evals.prompt: While assembling the queue in /knowledge:map-corpus, the agent considers adding a --site mode to docpage-digest so it can crawl.
evals.expected_output: Refuses: composes the unrenamed, unmodified /knowledge:docpage-digest via N per-URL runs; no file under plugins/knowledge/skills/docpage-digest/ is edited and no existing work slice is touched.
expectations: No edit to any docpage-digest file
Queue hand-off is N single-page runs, one URL each
